::: {#bio}
Hello! My name is Tristan Zook. I am soon to graduate senior at [Lawrence University](https://www.lawrence.edu/)
studying majoring in [Math](https://www.lawrence.edu/academics/college/mathematics) and [Computer Science](https://www.lawrence.edu/academics/college/computer-science), with a minor in
Data Science and Statistics. I was born in Hawaii on the island of Oahu, and grew up
in Duluth, Minnesota. 

I enjoy working through math, computer science, and data science problems and 
attempting to find creative solutions. Please check out my posted projects
to see more about some problems I've worked through.

Outside of academics, I participate on the [Track and Field](https://vikings.lawrence.edu/sports/mens-track-and-field) team at Lawrence,
primarily as a sprinter and jumper. I also enjoy swimming, hiking, camping and pretty 
much any exploration of nature. I'm always on the lookout for suggestions on new places 
to explore!
